title: Summer Has Passed
synopsis: Anne writes about her recent experiences in her diary.

fullText.simplified:
夏天过去了

    时间过得真快，夏天突然就过去了。现在是中午一点一刻，天上有太阳，但一点儿都不热，空调终于可以休息了。
    上周我和小北、高天去爬山了。因为太热，我们选择晚上爬山。一路上都有月亮和路灯，看得很清楚。我们先去超市买了饮料、蛋糕和香蕉，然后再去爬山。有段山路不好走，我们休息了好几次。休息的时候，饮料被高天喝完了，蛋糕被我吃完了。小北买了两公斤香蕉，我们只吃了一公斤。后来我们带着没吃完的一公斤香蕉爬到了山上。虽然腿和脚都累极了，但我们在那儿看到了新世界。月亮在天上，城市的灯火在眼前，它们像画一样，漂亮极了。山上有很多年轻人，几乎都是大学生。大家很高兴，像过什么节日一样，热情地坐在一起聊天和吃东西。
    昨天小北和高天帮一个叫白雪的女孩搬家去了。白雪以前的房子太旧了，洗手间很小，洗澡不方便。电梯和灯经常坏，环境很差，邻居也不太好。她想换个好点的房子。她换了个只有七层的矮楼房，她住在第六层。新房子的洗手间又大又干净，她很满意。那儿离学校很近，邻居其实都是她的同学。听高天说，白雪是个又漂亮又热情的女孩，有一头黑色的短发。她和小北的关系不错，我应该有机会和她见面。
    最后一件事，今天我坐了一辆出租车，这辆车的司机很特别。他今年四十八岁，在北京开了二十多年出租车了，是个老司机。他说他的老家在西北，黄河边上的一个小城市。他妻子十多年前病了，身体不好，需要人照顾。他已经照顾她十多年了。最近他妻子的身体终于好一些了，能自己刷牙、洗脸和洗头发了。他很高兴，说等妻子再好一些了，就和妻子一起回西北老家去看看。今天的天气很奇怪，早上大太阳，中午太阳不见了，突然开始刮风下雨，每辆车都着急地想开快点儿。但那个司机一点儿都不着急，他说他已经习惯这种天气了。他小心开车，很热情，脸上带着笑，让人觉得很舒服。我希望他的妻子快点儿好起来，他们太不容易了。
fullText.traditional:
夏天過去了

    時間過得真快，夏天突然就過去了。現在是中午一點一刻，天上有太陽，但一點兒都不熱，空調終於可以休息了。
    上周我和小北、高天去爬山了。因為太熱，我們選擇晚上爬山。一路上都有月亮和路燈，看得很清楚。我們先去超市買了飲料、蛋糕和香蕉，然後再去爬山。有段山路不好走，我們休息了好幾次。休息的時候，飲料被高天喝完了，蛋糕被我吃完了。小北買了兩公斤香蕉，我們只吃了一公斤。後來我們帶著沒吃完的一公斤香蕉爬到了山上。雖然腿和腳都累極了，但我們在那兒看到了新世界。月亮在天上，城市的燈火在眼前，它們像畫一樣，漂亮極了。山上有很多年輕人，幾乎都是大學生。大家很高興，像過什麼節日一樣，熱情地坐在一起聊天和吃東西。
    昨天小北和高天幫一個叫白雪的女孩搬家去了。白雪以前的房子太舊了，洗手間很小，洗澡不方便。電梯和燈經常壞，環境很差，鄰居也不太好。她想換個好點的房子。她換了個只有七層的矮樓房，她住在第六層。新房子的洗手間又大又乾淨，她很滿意。那兒離學校很近，鄰居其實都是她的同學。聽高天說，白雪是個又漂亮又熱情的女孩，有一頭黑色的短髮。她和小北的關係不錯，我應該有機會和她見面。
    最後一件事，今天我坐了一輛出租車，這輛車的司機很特別。他今年四十八歲，在北京開了二十多年出租車了，是個老司機。他說他的老家在西北，黃河邊上的一個小城市。他妻子十多年前病了，身體不好，需要人照顧。他已經照顧她十多年了。最近他妻子的身體終於好一些了，能自己刷牙、洗臉和洗頭髮了。他很高興，說等妻子再好一些了，就和妻子一起回西北老家去看看。今天的天氣很奇怪，早上大太陽，中午太陽不見了，突然開始颳風下雨，每輛車都著急地想開快點兒。但那個司機一點兒都不著急，他說他已經習慣這種天氣了。他小心開車，很熱情，臉上帶著笑，讓人覺得很舒服。我希望他的妻子快點兒好起來，他們太不容易了。

sentences.simplified: 时间过得真快，夏天突然就过去了。
sentences.traditional: 時間過得真快，夏天突然就過去了。
sentences.pinyin: shí jiān guò de zhēn kuài xià tiān tū rán jiù guò qù le
sentences.english: Time flies, and summer has passed all of a sudden.

sentences.simplified: 现在是中午一点一刻，天上有太阳，
sentences.traditional: 現在是中午一點一刻，天上有太陽，
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài shì zhōng wǔ yī diǎn yí kè tiān shàng yǒu tài yáng
sentences.english: It’s now a quarter past one in the afternoon, and the sun is shining in the sky.

sentences.simplified: 但一点儿都不热，空调终于可以休息了。
sentences.traditional: 但一點兒都不熱，空調終於可以休息了。
sentences.pinyin: dàn yì diǎn'r dōu bú rè kōng tiáo zhōng yú kě yǐ xiū xi le
sentences.english: But it is not hot at all, and the air conditioner can finally take a break.

sentences.simplified: 上周我和小北、高天去爬山了。因为太热，我们选择晚上爬山。
sentences.traditional: 上周我和小北、高天去爬山了。因為太熱，我們選擇晚上爬山。
sentences.pinyin: shàng zhōu wǒ hé xiǎo běi gāo tiān qù pá shān le yīn wèi tài rè wǒ men xuǎn zé wǎn shang pá shān
sentences.english: Last week, Xiaobei, Gao Tian, and I went hiking. Because it was too hot, we chose to hike at night.

sentences.simplified: 一路上都有月亮和路灯，看得很清楚。
sentences.traditional: 一路上都有月亮和路燈，看得很清楚。
sentences.pinyin: yí lù shang dōu yǒu yuè liang hé lù dēng kàn de hěn qīng chu
sentences.english: There was moonlight and streetlights along the way, so we could see clearly.

sentences.simplified: 我们先去超市买了饮料、蛋糕和香蕉，然后再去爬山。
sentences.traditional: 我們先去超市買了飲料、蛋糕和香蕉，然後再去爬山。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ men xiān qù chāo shì mǎi le yǐn liào dàn gāo hé xiāng jiāo rán hòu zài qù pá shān
sentences.english: We first went to the supermarket to buy drinks, cakes, and bananas, and then went hiking.

sentences.simplified: 有段山路不好走，我们休息了好几次。
sentences.traditional: 有段山路不好走，我們休息了好幾次。
sentences.pinyin: yǒu duàn shān lù bù hǎo zǒu wǒ men xiū xi le hǎo jǐ cì
sentences.english: There was a section of the mountain road that was difficult to walk, and we rested several times.

sentences.simplified: 休息的时候，饮料被高天喝完了，蛋糕被我吃完了。
sentences.traditional: 休息的時候，飲料被高天喝完了，蛋糕被我吃完了。
sentences.pinyin: xiū xi de shí hou yǐn liào bèi gāo tiān hē wán le dàn gāo bèi wǒ chī wán le
sentences.english: While we were resting, all the drinks were finished by Gao Tian, and all the cakes were finished by me.

sentences.simplified: 小北买了两公斤香蕉，我们只吃了一公斤。
sentences.traditional: 小北買了兩公斤香蕉，我們只吃了一公斤。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo běi mǎi le liǎng gōng jīn xiāng jiāo wǒ men zhǐ chī le yì gōng jīn
sentences.english: Xiaobei bought two kilograms of bananas, but we only ate one kilogram.

sentences.simplified: 后来我们带着没吃完的一公斤香蕉爬到了山上。
sentences.traditional: 後來我們帶著沒吃完的一公斤香蕉爬到了山上。
sentences.pinyin: hòu lái wǒ men dài zhe méi chī wán de yì gōng jīn xiāng jiāo pá dào le shān shang
sentences.english: Later, we carried the one kilogram of uneaten bananas up the mountain.

sentences.simplified: 虽然腿和脚都累极了，但我们在那儿看到了新世界。
sentences.traditional: 雖然腿和腳都累極了，但我們在那兒看到了新世界。
sentences.pinyin: suī rán tuǐ hé jiǎo dōu lèi jí le dàn wǒ men zài nà'r kàn dào le xīn shì jiè
sentences.english: Although our legs and feet were extremely tired, we saw a new world there.

sentences.simplified: 月亮在天上，城市的灯火在眼前，它们像画一样，漂亮极了。
sentences.traditional: 月亮在天上，城市的燈火在眼前，它們像畫一樣，漂亮極了。
sentences.pinyin: yuè liang zài tiān shàng chéng shì de dēng huǒ zài yǎn qián tā men xiàng huà yí yàng piào liang jí le
sentences.english: The moon was in the sky, and the city lights were before our eyes. It looked like a painting. It was incredibly beautiful.

sentences.simplified: 山上有很多年轻人，几乎都是大学生。
sentences.traditional: 山上有很多年輕人，幾乎都是大學生。
sentences.pinyin: shān shang yǒu hěn duō nián qīng rén jī hū dōu shì dà xué shēng
sentences.english: There were many young people on the mountain. Almost all of them were college students.

sentences.simplified: 大家很高兴，像过什么节日一样，热情地坐在一起聊天和吃东西。
sentences.traditional: 大家很高興，像過什麼節日一樣，熱情地坐在一起聊天和吃東西。
sentences.pinyin: dà jiā hěn gāo xìng xiàng guò shén me jié rì yí yàng rè qíng de zuò zài yì qǐ liáo tiān hé chī dōng xi
sentences.english: Everyone was very happy, as if celebrating a festival, enthusiastically sitting together, chatting and eating.

sentences.simplified: 昨天小北和高天帮一个叫白雪的女孩搬家去了。
sentences.traditional: 昨天小北和高天幫一個叫白雪的女孩搬家去了。
sentences.pinyin: zuó tiān xiǎo běi hé gāo tiān bāng yí ge jiào bái xuě de nǚ hái bān jiā qù le
sentences.english: Yesterday, Xiaobei and Gao Tian helped a girl named Bai Xue move.

sentences.simplified: 白雪以前的房子太旧了，洗手间很小，洗澡不方便。
sentences.traditional: 白雪以前的房子太舊了，洗手間很小，洗澡不方便。
sentences.pinyin: bái xuě yǐ qián de fáng zi tài jiù le xǐ shǒu jiān hěn xiǎo xǐ zǎo bù fāng biàn
sentences.english: Bai Xue’s old apartment was too old. The bathroom was tiny, and it wasn’t convenient for taking a shower.

sentences.simplified: 电梯和灯经常坏，环境很差，邻居也不太好。
sentences.traditional: 電梯和燈經常壞，環境很差，鄰居也不太好。
sentences.pinyin: diàn tī hé dēng jīng cháng huài huán jìng hěn chà lín jū yě bú tài hǎo
sentences.english: The elevator and lights often broke, the environment was poor, and the neighbors weren’t very nice either.

sentences.simplified: 她想换个好点的房子。
sentences.traditional: 她想換個好點的房子。
sentences.pinyin: tā xiǎng huàn ge hǎo diǎn de fáng zi
sentences.english: She wanted to move to a better apartment.

sentences.simplified: 她换了个只有七层的矮楼房，她住在第六层。
sentences.traditional: 她換了個只有七層的矮樓房，她住在第六層。
sentences.pinyin: tā huàn le ge zhǐ yǒu qī céng de ǎi lóu fáng tā zhù zài dì liù céng
sentences.english: She moved to a low-rise building with only seven floors, and she lives on the sixth floor.

sentences.simplified: 新房子的洗手间又大又干净，她很满意。
sentences.traditional: 新房子的洗手間又大又乾淨，她很滿意。
sentences.pinyin: xīn fáng zi de xǐ shǒu jiān yòu dà yòu gān jìng tā hěn mǎn yì
sentences.english: The bathroom in the new apartment is large and clean, and she is very satisfied.

sentences.simplified: 那儿离学校很近，邻居其实都是她的同学。
sentences.traditional: 那兒離學校很近，鄰居其實都是她的同學。
sentences.pinyin: nà'r lí xué xiào hěn jìn lín jū qí shí dōu shì tā de tóng xué
sentences.english: It is very close to the school, and the neighbors are actually all her classmates.

sentences.simplified: 听高天说，白雪是个又漂亮又热情的女孩，有一头黑色的短发。
sentences.traditional: 聽高天說，白雪是個又漂亮又熱情的女孩，有一頭黑色的短髮。
sentences.pinyin: tīng gāo tiān shuō bái xuě shì ge yòu piào liang yòu rè qíng de nǚ hái yǒu yì tóu hēi sè de duǎn fà
sentences.english: I heard from Gao Tian that Bai Xue is a beautiful and warmhearted girl with short black hair.

sentences.simplified: 她和小北的关系不错，我应该有机会和她见面。
sentences.traditional: 她和小北的關係不錯，我應該有機會和她見面。
sentences.pinyin: tā hé xiǎo běi de guān xi bú cuò wǒ yīng gāi yǒu jī huì hé tā jiàn miàn
sentences.english: She has a good relationship with Xiaobei, so I should have a chance to meet her.

sentences.simplified: 最后一件事，今天我坐了一辆出租车，这辆车的司机很特别。
sentences.traditional: 最後一件事，今天我坐了一輛出租車，這輛車的司機很特別。
sentences.pinyin: zuì hòu yí jiàn shì jīn tiān wǒ zuò le yí liàng chū zū chē zhè liàng chē de sī jī hěn tè bié
sentences.english: The last thing is that I took a taxi today, and the driver was very special.

sentences.simplified: 他今年四十八岁，在北京开了二十多年出租车了，是个老司机。
sentences.traditional: 他今年四十八歲，在北京開了二十多年出租車了，是個老司機。
sentences.pinyin: tā jīn nián sì shí bā suì zài běi jīng kāi le èr shí duō nián chū zū chē le shì ge lǎo sī jī
sentences.english: He is forty-eight years old and has been driving a taxi in Beijing for more than twenty years, a veteran driver.

sentences.simplified: 他说他的老家在西北，黄河边上的一个小城市。
sentences.traditional: 他說他的老家在西北，黃河邊上的一個小城市。
sentences.pinyin: tā shuō tā de lǎo jiā zài xī běi huáng hé biān shang de yí ge xiǎo chéng shì
sentences.english: He said his hometown is in the northwest, a small city by the Yellow River.

sentences.simplified: 他妻子十多年前病了，身体不好，需要人照顾。
sentences.traditional: 他妻子十多年前病了，身體不好，需要人照顧。
sentences.pinyin: tā qī zi shí duō nián qián bìng le shēn tǐ bù hǎo xū yào rén zhào gù
sentences.english: His wife got sick more than ten years ago. Her health isn’t good, and she needs someone to take care of her.

sentences.simplified: 他已经照顾她十多年了。
sentences.traditional: 他已經照顧她十多年了。
sentences.pinyin: tā yǐ jīng zhào gù tā shí duō nián le
sentences.english: He has been taking care of her for more than ten years.

sentences.simplified: 最近他妻子的身体终于好一些了，能自己刷牙、洗脸和洗头发了。
sentences.traditional: 最近他妻子的身體終於好一些了，能自己刷牙、洗臉和洗頭髮了。
sentences.pinyin: zuì jìn tā qī zi de shēn tǐ zhōng yú hǎo yì xiē le néng zì jǐ shuā yá xǐ liǎn hé xǐ tóu fa le
sentences.english: Recently, his wife’s health has finally improved a bit, and she can brush her teeth, wash her face, and wash her hair by herself.

sentences.simplified: 他很高兴，说等妻子再好一些了，
sentences.traditional: 他很高興，說等妻子再好一些了，
sentences.pinyin: tā hěn gāo xìng shuō děng qī zi zài hǎo yì xiē le
sentences.english: He was very happy and said that once his wife’s health gets a bit better, ..

sentences.simplified: 就和妻子一起回西北老家去看看。
sentences.traditional: 就和妻子一起回西北老家去看看。
sentences.pinyin: jiù hé qī zi yì qǐ huí xī běi lǎo jiā qù kàn kan
sentences.english: .. he’ll go back to his hometown in the northwest with his wife for a visit.

sentences.simplified: 今天的天气很奇怪，早上大太阳，中午太阳不见了，
sentences.traditional: 今天的天氣很奇怪，早上大太陽，中午太陽不見了，
sentences.pinyin: jīn tiān de tiān qì hěn qí guài zǎo shang dà tài yáng zhōng wǔ tài yáng bú jiàn le
sentences.english: Today’s weather was strange. It was sunny in the morning. At noon, the sun disappeared.

sentences.simplified: 突然开始刮风下雨，每辆车都着急地想开快点儿。
sentences.traditional: 突然開始颳風下雨，每輛車都著急地想開快點兒。

sentences.english: It suddenly started to rain and got windy. Every car was in a hurry to drive faster.

sentences.simplified: 但那个司机一点儿都不着急，他说他已经习惯这种天气了。
sentences.traditional: 但那個司機一點兒都不著急，他說他已經習慣這種天氣了。

sentences.english: But this driver was not in a hurry at all. He said he was used to this kind of weather.

sentences.simplified: 他小心开车，很热情，脸上带着笑，让人觉得很舒服。
sentences.traditional: 他小心開車，很熱情，臉上帶著笑，讓人覺得很舒服。
sentences.pinyin: tā xiǎo xīn kāi chē hěn rè qíng liǎn shang dài zhe xiào ràng rén jué de hěn shū fu
sentences.english: He drove carefully and was very warmhearted, with a smile on his face that made people feel at ease.

sentences.simplified: 我希望他的妻子快点儿好起来，他们太不容易了。
sentences.traditional: 我希望他的妻子快點兒好起來，他們太不容易了。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ xī wàng tā de qī zi kuài diǎn'r hǎo qǐ lái tā men tài bù róng yì le
sentences.english: I hope his wife gets better soon. They have had a hard time.

sentence_translations: Summer Has Passed
Time flies, and summer has passed all of a sudden.
It’s now a quarter past one in the afternoon, and the sun is shining in the sky.
But it is not hot at all, and the air conditioner can finally take a break.
Last week, Xiaobei, Gao Tian, and I went hiking. Because it was too hot, we chose to hike at night.
There was moonlight and streetlights along the way, so we could see clearly.
We first went to the supermarket to buy drinks, cakes, and bananas, and then went hiking.
There was a section of the mountain road that was difficult to walk, and we rested several times.
While we were resting, all the drinks were finished by Gao Tian, and all the cakes were finished by me.
Xiaobei bought two kilograms of bananas, but we only ate one kilogram.
Later, we carried the one kilogram of uneaten bananas up the mountain.
Although our legs and feet were extremely tired, we saw a new world there.
The moon was in the sky, and the city lights were before our eyes. It looked like a painting. It was incredibly beautiful.
There were many young people on the mountain. Almost all of them were college students.
Everyone was very happy, as if celebrating a festival, enthusiastically sitting together, chatting and eating.
Yesterday, Xiaobei and Gao Tian helped a girl named Bai Xue move.
Bai Xue’s old apartment was too old. The bathroom was tiny, and it wasn’t convenient for taking a shower.
The elevator and lights often broke, the environment was poor, and the neighbors weren’t very nice either.
She wanted to move to a better apartment.
She moved to a low-rise building with only seven floors, and she lives on the sixth floor.
The bathroom in the new apartment is large and clean, and she is very satisfied.
It is very close to the school, and the neighbors are actually all her classmates.
I heard from Gao Tian that Bai Xue is a beautiful and warmhearted girl with short black hair.
She has a good relationship with Xiaobei, so I should have a chance to meet her.
The last thing is that I took a taxi today, and the driver was very special.
He is forty-eight years old and has been driving a taxi in Beijing for more than twenty years, a veteran driver.
He said his hometown is in the northwest, a small city by the Yellow River.
His wife got sick more than ten years ago. Her health isn’t good, and she needs someone to take care of her.
He has been taking care of her for more than ten years.
Recently, his wife’s health has finally improved a bit, and she can brush her teeth, wash her face, and wash her hair by herself.
He was very happy and said that once his wife’s health gets a bit better, ..
.. he’ll go back to his hometown in the northwest with his wife for a visit.
Today’s weather was strange. It was sunny in the morning. At noon, the sun disappeared.
It suddenly started to rain and got windy. Every car was in a hurry to drive faster.
But this driver was not in a hurry at all. He said he was used to this kind of weather.
He drove carefully and was very warmhearted, with a smile on his face that made people feel at ease.
I hope his wife gets better soon. They have had a hard time.
